title: Email and Lifecycle Marketing Specialist (Remote) | Philippines
description:
• Job Type: Full-time, long-term contractor
  • Workplace: Remote
  • Schedule: Full-time, Monday to Friday - 9:00 am - 6:00 pm EST
  • Compensation: $1,800 - $2,000

About Us

HireHawk connects skilled professionals around the world with meaningful remote opportunities at U.S. and Canadian companies. We build globally distributed teams around people who take ownership, communicate clearly, and deliver at a high standard.

For this opportunity, you will support a direct-to-consumer subscription business where lifecycle marketing plays a central role in customer experience, retention, and long-term revenue.

About the Role

As an Email / Lifecycle Marketing Specialist, you will own hands-on execution across email, SMS, segmentation, retention, deliverability, and reporting. You will personally build and maintain Klaviyo campaigns, automations, and lifecycle flows while managing the connection between Klaviyo and Recharge.

This is an individual contributor role for someone who enjoys being close to the work. You will be expected to understand the strategy behind each campaign, but you will also be the person building, testing, troubleshooting, launching, and optimizing it.

Because the business operates on a subscription model, your work will directly influence churn reduction, repeat purchases, upgrades, winbacks, and customer lifetime value.

Working hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST.

Responsibilities

  • Own and continuously improve the Klaviyo flow architecture across acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, winback, and other key lifecycle stages.
  • Build, test, schedule, and launch email campaigns independently while maintaining an accurate campaign calendar.
  • Develop customer segments that enable more relevant messaging, stronger personalization, and better lifecycle performance.
  • Build and execute SMS campaigns and automations as part of an integrated email and retention strategy.
  • Own retention initiatives including churn-save programs, winback campaigns, upgrade offers, subscription messaging, and other customer lifecycle experiments.
  • Manage and troubleshoot the Klaviyo and Recharge integration to ensure subscription and customer data flows accurately between platforms.
  • Monitor email deliverability, list health, sender performance, and engagement signals, and resolve issues before they negatively affect results.
  • Analyze lifecycle performance and translate campaign, flow, and customer data into clear reporting and actionable recommendations.
  • Design and run thoughtful tests across messaging, offers, segmentation, timing, and lifecycle journeys, explaining the rationale behind each test.
  • Troubleshoot execution issues independently using platform documentation, support resources, and AI tools before escalating routine problems.

Requirements

Must-Have:

  • 3-6+ years of experience in lifecycle, retention, CRM, or email marketing, with flexibility on exact seniority for candidates with strong hands-on experience.
  • Deep, hands-on Klaviyo experience, including personally building campaigns, automations, flows, segments, and reporting.
  • DTC or e-commerce lifecycle marketing experience.
  • Experience designing and maintaining lifecycle flow architecture rather than only managing or reviewing other people's work.
  • Hands-on experience with customer segmentation, SMS marketing, email deliverability, and list health.
  • Experience executing retention programs such as churn-save initiatives, winbacks, subscription offers, upgrades, or similar lifecycle campaigns.
  • Ability to work independently, troubleshoot problems, follow detailed instructions accurately, and take ownership through completion.
  • Hands-on knowledge of the Klaviyo + Recharge integration and subscription data flows.

Nice to Have:

  • Strong experience with subscription-based e-commerce businesses.
  • Experience creating email assets in Canva, Photoshop, or AI-powered creative tools.
  • Experience developing lifecycle strategy and explaining the reasoning behind campaign, segmentation, testing, and automation decisions.
  • Familiarity with using AI tools to accelerate creative production, analysis, research, and troubleshooting.

title: Recruiter, Performance Marketing
description:
Jump 450 is looking for a Performance Marketing Recruiter to help us hire elite talent across performance marketing, creative, and agency operations. You’ll partner closely with recruiting leadership, People Operations, and hiring managers to turn hiring needs into focused searches and guide candidates from first conversation through offer.

We hold a high bar for hiring. Our process is designed to understand how candidates think, what they’ve personally executed, and the results they can deliver for our clients. You’ll play a central role in that assessment while building relationships that keep great candidates engaged through a thorough, multistage process.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with hiring managers and recruiting leadership to define role requirements, hiring priorities, and what exceptional performance looks like in each position.
  • Own searches from sourcing through offer, including outreach, recruiter screens, candidate assessment, hiring team partnership, feedback, and closing conversations.
  • Find and engage passive candidates through targeted research, personalized outreach, referrals, and long-term relationship building.
  • Recruit across paid media, performance marketing, creative, and other agency functions, developing a strong understanding of the platforms, hands-on skills, and results required for each role.
  • Lead initial interviews that explore candidates’ personal contributions, technical depth, judgment, career goals, and compensation expectations.
  • Present candidates to hiring teams with clear, evidence-based recommendations, including relevant strengths and areas to explore further.
  • Guide candidates through a process that includes technical assessments, culture interviews, and executive conversations. Help them understand each stage and stay engaged throughout.
  • Partner with the recruiting coordinator on interview logistics while remaining the candidate’s primary point of contact for substantive updates, questions, and feedback.
  • Work with interviewers to gather timely, specific feedback, address open questions, and keep hiring decisions moving.
  • Maintain accurate candidate records, interview notes, feedback, and pipeline stages in Workable.
  • Use Workday to track requisitions and support accurate hiring records, approvals, and offer processes.
  • Keep job descriptions and requisition details current as roles and hiring priorities change.
  • Support compensation and offer conversations, and help ensure a smooth handoff after a candidate accepts.
  • Use AI tools to improve sourcing, research, outreach, and recruiting workflows while applying independent judgment to candidate evaluation and communication.
  • Identify ways to improve our assessment process, candidate experience, and recruiting operations.

Requirements

  • At least 5 years of recruiting experience, including experience at a marketing or advertising agency, staffing agency, or in another fast-paced environment.
  • A track record of identifying and engaging high-performing passive candidates for specialized roles.
  • Experience partnering directly with hiring managers and managing multiple searches with different priorities and stakeholders.
  • The ability to evaluate what candidates have personally done, how deeply they understand their craft, and whether their experience matches the needs of the role.
  • Strong interviewing skills and the confidence to ask follow-up questions that get beyond rehearsed answers.
  • Sound judgment about when to advocate for a candidate, raise a concern, or recalibrate a search.
  • Strong candidate management skills, including clear communication through a thorough interview process.
  • Comfort discussing compensation, navigating offer conversations, and helping candidates make informed decisions.
  • Excellent organization and attention to detail across candidate pipelines, requisitions, and hiring systems.
  • Experience with applicant tracking systems; experience with Workable and Workday is a plus.
  • Curiosity about new recruiting tools, including practical uses of AI.

Benefits

Our Mission

We strive to empower outstanding people to exceed our client’s expectations by providing them with the best resources, merit-based incentives and tools to transform data into actionable insights. Join us on our purpose to provide scalable, strategic and indispensable value to our clients.

About Jump 450

Jump 450, an Omnicom Media Group Agency, is based in New York City but employs experts throughout the world. We are a high-growth digital performance marketing agency that has seen rapid growth of over 150% over the past four year and doubled our staff. Jump’s exceptional culture, employee development approach, team engagement, perks, and benefits were just part of the reason publications like Fast Company Magazine, Inc Magazine, Agency Spotter’sTop 30 Agencies 2021 and Ad Age Best Places to Work chose to highlight Jump. We are also an Inc 5000 Company and have a >90% team member retention for professional reasons.

Jump 450 is the highest paying performance marketing agency in America. Our lucrative employee compensation model is perhaps one of our most compelling features–one that incentivizes our team to drive meaningful returns for our clients. Jump offers uncapped compensation for employees by sharing ~40% of top-line revenues with the team each and every month. On average our sales, media buying, and creative teams make 400% higher than the average for their roles in the US.

This work environment has created a triangle of alignment between company management, our employees, and our clients. We only hire experts, then provide additional learning and development so that our clients are receiving only the highest quality of output from real professionals. Among Jump's six core values are problem solving, ownership, execution, thought leadership, innovation, and collaboration. Our culture encourages team members to take calculated risks, actively look for innovation and creativity, and seek out ideas from all layers within the organization.

In addition to our beautiful New York office space (Brookfield Place), employees are encouraged to work from their home or wherever they feel most comfortable. They can choose to work from the office, their home, or at the coffee shop.

Additional benefits include:

  • Competitive salary with performance-based bonuses.
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Paid time off and holidays.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • A creative and collaborative work environment where your ideas and contributions are valued.
  • Additional benefits include
    • Life and Accident Insurance Plans
    • Short and Long Term Disability Plans
    • Employee Assistance Programs
    • Paid Parental Leave
    • Family Forming Plans
    • Cigna Secure Travel
    • Health Savings Account (HDS)
    • Health Care Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
    • Limited Purpose FSA
    • Dependent Care FSA
    • Access to MetLife Legal Plan Services
    • 401k Match Plans
    • Access to Virtual Health Services
    • Remote Working Flexibility
    • New MacBook Pros

title: Social & Community Marketing Manager
description:
Some brands post content. Others make people stop scrolling. We're looking for someone who knows the difference. Someone who lives and breathes social media, is fascinated by startups and marketing, and can turn bold ideas into content that gets people talking, following, and coming back for more. If you've ever looked at a brand's social media and thought, "I could do that ten times better," we want to meet you.

You'll join a fast-growing tech startup, where you'll turn social media into a powerful engine for audience growth, brand awareness, and demand generation. You'll own the company's social presence, help founders build their personal brands, and create content people actually want to watch, read, and share.

There's no established playbook waiting for you. You'll be expected to bring the ideas, build the systems, experiment relentlessly, and make things happen. If you're constantly thinking "I could make better content than that," we want to see what you've got.


Responsibilities

  • Own the organic social strategy across LinkedIn, X, TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube, creating content that grows audiences and drives business interest.
  • Build a consistent short-form video engine, from creative concepts and hooks to production, publishing, and optimization.
  • Turn startup stories, marketing trends, and creator economy insights into compelling, platform-native content.
  • Develop founder and employee-led content, transforming executive insights into engaging posts and videos that build personal brands.
  • Create scalable content workflows and publishing cadences that keep company and employee accounts consistently active.
  • Experiment with formats, storytelling, and distribution strategies, using performance data to double down on what works.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, creators, and production partners to bring content ideas to life.
  • Identify opportunities to engage the creator community and turn social attention into brand awareness, traffic, and sign-ups.

Requirements

  • Proven ability to create standout social content or grow an audience, backed by real examples of your work and results.
  • Deep understanding of LinkedIn, X, TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube, including what makes content perform on each platform.
  • Strong creative instincts, copywriting, and storytelling skills, especially for short-form video and attention-grabbing hooks.
  • Genuine interest in startups, business, marketing, and internet culture. You're not just consuming content; you're analyzing why it works.
  • Ability to build content systems, manage production schedules, and maintain a consistent publishing cadence.
  • Resourceful, experimental, and self-directed, with the confidence to bring ideas forward and execute without constant supervision.
  • Strong analytical skills to understand audience growth, engagement, and content performance.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate directly with founders and executives.

Nice to have

  • Experience growing social audiences for startups, B2B SaaS companies, or founder-led brands.
  • Experience with executive personal branding, employee advocacy, or creator-led marketing.
  • Hands-on video production or editing experience.
  • Familiarity with two-sided marketplaces, influencer marketing, or the creator economy.
  • Experience connecting organic social content to measurable traffic, sign-ups, or demand generation.
  • Experience with product-led growth (PLG) or self-serve SaaS business models, particularly using organic social content to drive user acquisition and sign-ups.

Benefits

  • Location: Hybrid, Vancouver, BC (3 days in office)
  • Salary: $60K–$90K CAD
  • PTO: 3 weeks paid vacation + statutory holidays + paid sick leave

title: Director of Performance Marketing, Calendar
description:
Skylight is a technology startup building the OS of the family. We make Skylight Calendar, the smart calendar loved by millions of families (plus Wired and the Wirecutter). Our latest product is Calendar 2, which just launched to rave reviews.

Skylight’s mission is to build the OS of the family. We make consumer products, like Skylight Frame and Skylight Calendar, that are loved by millions of people across the globe. Through a singular focus on care for our customers, Skylight has scaled from a school project to over $300M in annual revenue while being completely bootstrapped. We have a huge opportunity to make family life easier and more connected, and that’s why we have been working hard to expand our team.

We’re looking for a Director of Performance Marketing to own the core digital acquisition channels for Skylight Calendar. You’ll manage an eight-figure budget across channels like Meta, Google, TikTok and AppLovin. You’ll decide where the next dollar goes and build the testing and measurement program that tells us what’s really working. You’ll report to our Director of Growth and work closely with our creative, offline, influencer, ecommerce, brand, and retail teams. The ideal candidate is a strong communicator who thinks in marginal dollars and maximizing ROI and is as comfortable in an ad account as in a contribution model.

What you’ll own

  • Channel performance and budget
    • Optimize spend across digital channels continuously, maximizing growth while hitting blended and channel-level CAC and contribution targets
    • Build monthly, quarterly and promotional spend plans (holiday, Mother’s Day, new launches) tied to revenue, inventory and margin goals
    • Design campaign structure for algorithmic performance; oversee optimization strategy and manage small teams to execute channel plans. Step in to support with hands on keys adjustments as needed.
    • Test new channels and tactics with clear hypotheses, success criteria and thresholds for scaling
  • Incrementality and measurement
    • Own the roadmap for digital incrementality testing (geo-holdouts, lift studies) to guide channel mix decisions, validate spend and open up new tactics
    • Reconcile platform reporting with incrementality, MMM and post-purchase survey data, and define which signals drive decisions
    • Understand halo effects: how digital spend drives sales at retail and on Amazon, not just DTC
    • Work with ecommerce to test funnels and optimize conversion rate. 
  • Creative and testing
    • Work with the creative team, creative strategist, brand, and product marketing to set creative priorities and resourcing
    • Oversee a high-velocity creative testing program; support the Digital Performance Manager in balancing tradeoffs (velocity vs. quality)
    • Collaborate with marketing channel leads on testing roadmaps, including new audiences, messaging angles and offers
  • Leadership and communication
    • Lead and develop media buyers and analysts, and manage agency and platform partners
    • Explain performance clearly to leadership: what changed, why, and what we’ll do next

Requirements

  • 8+ years in performance marketing, with 3+ years in a growth leadership role at a consumer brand
  • Strong paid social and paid search competency at scale. Has managed an eight-figure annual budget across Meta, Google and at least one other channel, allocating spend based on marginal returns
  • Has designed and run incrementality tests and used MMM or causal measurement to make spend decisions. 
  • Deep fluency in unit economics: CAC, MER, contribution margin, payback and LTV
  • Strong creative instincts, with the ability to turn performance data into briefs that produce winning ads
  • Strong technical understanding of signal infrastructure (e.g. pixels, Conversions API, server-side tracking and first-party data)
  • Comfortable pulling your own data (SQL or BI tools like Omni or Looker are a plus)
  • Bonus: omnichannel experience where digital spend supports retail, or experience with hardware plus subscription businesses

Benefits

Our competitive compensation package includes:

  • Competitive Salary + Equity Package
  • 401K matching
  • Wellness, learning, and home-office budgets
  • Health, Dental & Vision Medical Plans
  • Tremendous autonomy to set the direction of your work
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Company holidays on the first Friday of every month (Excluding November, December, and January)

Equal opportunity employer

Skylight is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. If you’re the best person for the job, we want you on board!

We hire across the U.S., but for legal reasons, we have to list NY and CO separately.

For Colorado-based candidates, the range being offered for this role is $180k - 210k based on experience and for California-based candidates, the range being offered for this role is $180k - 210k based on experience. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment for qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of this law.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

    • Build monthly, quarterly and promotional spend plans (holiday, Mother’s Day, new launches) tied to revenue, inventory and margin goals
    • Design campaign structure for algorithmic performance; oversee optimization strategy and manage small teams to execute channel plans. Step in to support with hands on keys adjustments as needed.
    • Test new channels and tactics with clear hypotheses, success criteria and thresholds for scaling
  • Incrementality and measurement
    • Own the roadmap for digital incrementality testing (geo-holdouts, lift studies) to guide channel mix decisions, validate spend and open up new tactics
    • Reconcile platform reporting with incrementality, MMM and post-purchase survey data, and define which signals drive decisions
    • Understand halo effects: how digital spend drives sales at retail and on Amazon, not just DTC
    • Work with ecommerce to test funnels and optimize conversion rate. 
  • Creative and testing
    • Work with the creative team, creative strategist, brand, and product marketing to set creative priorities and resourcing
    • Oversee a high-velocity creative testing program; support the Digital Performance Manager in balancing tradeoffs (velocity vs. quality)
    • Collaborate with marketing channel leads on testing roadmaps, including new audiences, messaging angles and offers
  • Leadership and communication
    • Lead and develop media buyers and analysts, and manage agency and platform partners
    • Explain performance clearly to leadership: what changed, why, and what we’ll do next

Requirements

  • 8+ years in performance marketing, with 3+ years in a growth leadership role at a consumer brand
  • Strong paid social and paid search competency at scale. Has managed an eight-figure annual budget across Meta, Google and at least one other channel, allocating spend based on marginal returns
  • Has designed and run incrementality tests and used MMM or causal measurement to make spend decisions. 
  • Deep fluency in unit economics: CAC, MER, contribution margin, payback and LTV
  • Strong creative instincts, with the ability to turn performance data into briefs that produce winning ads
  • Strong technical understanding of signal infrastructure (e.g. pixels, Conversions API, server-side tracking and first-party data)
  • Comfortable pulling your own data (SQL or BI tools like Omni or Looker are a plus)
  • Bonus: omnichannel experience where digital spend supports retail, or experience with hardware plus subscription businesses

Benefits

Our competitive compensation package includes:

  • Competitive Salary + Equity Package
  • 401K matching
  • Wellness, learning, and home-office budgets
  • Health, Dental & Vision Medical Plans
  • Tremendous autonomy to set the direction of your work
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Company holidays on the first Friday of every month (Excluding November, December, and January)

Equal opportunity employer

Skylight is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. If you’re the best person for the job, we want you on board!

We hire across the U.S., but for legal reasons, we have to list NY and CO separately.

For Colorado-based candidates, the range being offered for this role is $180k - 210k based on experience and for California-based candidates, the range being offered for this role is $180k - 210k based on experience. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment for qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of this law.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

title: Head of Marketing Operations & Growth
description:
About Workana

Workana is the largest remote work platform for talent in Latin America. Our division focuses on matching exceptional professionals with leading and innovative companies around the globe.

About the Client

Toolbox Widget is an established U.S. tool-accessory brand generating $5M–$10M in annual revenue, with a strong U.S. direct-to-consumer (DTC) footprint alongside Shopify operations across Canada, the UK, Australia, and ongoing expansion into the EU. The U.S. remains the company's primary focus and revenue driver.

We are looking for an experienced Head of Marketing Operations & Growth to lead integrated marketing strategy, manage specialized agencies and contractors, and take complete day-to-day operational ownership of the marketing function. This is a fully remote opportunity for professionals based in Latin America, collaborating closely with executive leadership in an English-speaking environment with significant U.S. time-zone overlap.

Role Overview

As the Head of Marketing Operations & Growth, you will serve as the central driver unifying strategy, campaign execution, and vendor management across all channels. Rather than executing individual channel tasks yourself, you will lead external agencies, contractors, and creators across PPC, email/SMS, SEO, CRO, social, and content marketing. You will ensure all teams work against a unified promotional calendar, deliver quality work on schedule, and protect unit economics and margins.

You will take ownership of major product launches, such as DIY 2.0 and Pro Series line expansions, and key seasonal events like Black Friday / Cyber Monday (BFCM), coordinating closely with supply chain and inventory teams to align marketing drive with stock availability. Additionally, you will establish repeatable operational workflows and deliver weekly executive reporting to ensure full visibility.

Selection Process

The process usually consists of 4 stages and takes on average 4–6 weeks to be completed, depending on eventual additional technical rounds or take-home tests.

  • Initial interview with Workana's recruiting team.
  • Technical interview with the client.
  • Cultural fit interview with the client's manager.
  • Final interview with C-level.

As Workana has multiple clients, if you pass the first round with Workana's recruiting team, you may also be considered for other relevant opportunities if the initial opportunity does not move forward.

Responsibilities

  • Own and execute one integrated marketing strategy, campaign calendar, marketing briefs, and accountability framework across all agencies, contractors, and creators.
  • Manage and hold accountable specialized external vendors covering paid media (PPC), email/SMS, SEO, CRO, social, and organic content.
  • Direct U.S. execution as the primary driver while establishing and adapting localized growth plans for Canada, the UK, Australia, and the EU.
  • Lead end-to-end affiliate and creator program management, including onboarding, brief creation, content deliverables, landing pages, tracking, and performance optimization.
  • Coordinate major product launches and promotional campaigns in close alignment with operations and inventory management to match demand with fulfillment.
  • Establish repeatable operational workflows, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and documentation so marketing execution runs autonomously.
  • Deliver a weekly executive dashboard tracking revenue, contribution margin, ad spend, ROAS/MER, customer acquisition, retention, and market-by-market performance.
  • Monitor cross-channel budgets and contribution profitability, proactively flagging and correcting underperforming channels or campaigns.

Requirements

  • Proven track record in a marketing leadership or operations role for a multi-million-dollar e-commerce/DTC brand on Shopify.
  • Demonstrated experience orchestrating, holding accountable, and directing multi-agency and contractor marketing setups.
  • Strong hands-on background managing affiliate, influencer, and creator marketing programs.
  • Solid understanding of multi-channel DTC metrics, including unit economics, contribution margins, MER, ROAS, CAC, and LTV.
  • Experience planning and executing major promotional events (e.g., BFCM) and product launches in coordination with inventory/operations teams.
  • Ability to work independently with high autonomy and build scalable marketing systems and processes.
  • Fluent English is mandatory, as the role involves daily written and verbal collaboration with U.S. leadership and international vendors.
  • Must be based in Latin America with significant daily working-hour overlap with U.S. time zones.

Bonus Points

  • Direct experience with international DTC expansion and adapting U.S. marketing strategy to localized international markets (CA, UK, AU, EU).
  • Familiarity with hardware, tool accessories, DIY, or automotive e-commerce categories.

Benefits

  • Compensation in USD.
  • Fully remote work within Latin America with flexible time schedules.
  • Career growth with international clients and dynamic projects.
  • This is a long-term independent contractor agreement.

title: Vendedor(a) B2B | Serviços Contábeis e Financeiros | 20 horas semanais
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Vendedor(a) B2B para integrar a equipe de uma empresa de serviços contábeis e financeiros, atuando na geração de oportunidades e no fechamento de novos negócios.

Nesta posição, você será responsável pelo ciclo completo de vendas, desde a prospecção e qualificação de potenciais clientes até a apresentação de soluções, negociação e fechamento de contratos. A atuação combina atividades de BDR e Closer, com autonomia para organizar as oportunidades comerciais e trabalhar com metas semanais.

Se você tem experiência em vendas consultivas, facilidade para construir relacionamentos e foco em resultados, queremos conhecer seu perfil!

Principais responsabilidades

  • Prospectar e identificar potenciais clientes B2B para os serviços contábeis e financeiros.
  • Realizar contatos comerciais e reuniões para entender as necessidades de cada cliente.
  • Qualificar oportunidades e apresentar soluções alinhadas aos desafios identificados.
  • Comunicar o valor dos serviços oferecidos e esclarecer dúvidas durante o processo comercial.
  • Elaborar e acompanhar propostas comerciais.
  • Conduzir negociações e atuar diretamente no fechamento de contratos.
  • Realizar follow-ups para avançar as oportunidades ao longo do ciclo de vendas.
  • Manter as informações e atividades comerciais organizadas e atualizadas.
  • Acompanhar os resultados e trabalhar para atingir as metas semanais de vendas.

Requisitos

  • Experiência de 3 a 5 anos em vendas B2B.
  • Experiência em prospecção, desenvolvimento de negócios, negociação e fechamento de vendas.
  • Habilidade para conduzir vendas consultivas e construir relacionamentos comerciais.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita em português.
  • Organização para gerenciar diferentes oportunidades e acompanhar negociações.
  • Autonomia, iniciativa e comprometimento com os resultados.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com metas e organizar as atividades comerciais dentro da carga horária disponível.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência na comercialização de serviços contábeis ou financeiros.
  • Conhecimento do mercado contábil e das necessidades das empresas que contratam esses serviços.

Condições da oportunidade

  • Carga horária: 20 horas semanais.
  • Remuneração: valor fixo mais comissões sobre as vendas realizadas.
  • Escopo: prospecção de novos clientes e gestão do ciclo completo de vendas B2B.

Perfil que buscamos

Buscamos uma pessoa com iniciativa para identificar oportunidades, capacidade de ouvir o cliente e habilidade para transformar suas necessidades em propostas de valor. Organização, constância nos acompanhamentos e comprometimento com as metas serão fundamentais para o sucesso nesta posição.

Candidate-se e ajude a conectar empresas às soluções contábeis e financeiras de que precisam!
